meta.name: Backup — API smoke test
meta.description: Triggers a full backup run via POST /api/backup-run with the BACKUP_SERVICE_KEY, then verifies the response reports zero failures. Also verifies that a request missing the service key is rejected (401 guard check).
meta.author: claude-ai

workflows.name: Backup — trigger and verify
workflows.description: POST /api/backup-run with the BACKUP_SERVICE_KEY header. Expects HTTP 200 and stores the succeeded/failed counts.

steps.description: Trigger a full backup run for all orgs. The endpoint loops over every organization and exports+encrypts+uploads tenant data.

workflows.name: Backup — reject request without service key
workflows.description: POST to the backup endpoint without the x-backup-service-key header. The endpoint must return 401. ignoreStatus prevents the runner from throwing on the expected 401 — a 200 here would indicate a broken auth guard.

steps.description: POST /api/backup-run with no service key — must return 401 Unauthorized
